args.title: Cold-chain logistics 2026: combined summary
args.body:
- Temperature excursions fell 30% where carriers shared live sensor data (Juniper blog, "Cold-chain logistics in 2026").
- Most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads, not from less spoilage.
- Companion piece (subscriber): pilot programs cut claims by about a quarter.

Sources: https://blog.juniper.example/2026/cold-chain ; https://insights.juniper.example/cold-chain/companion (opened with team subscription code)
